definitions: Compensate for the faults or bad aspects of (something).
Gain or regain possession of (something) in exchange for payment.
Save (someone) from sin, error, or evil.
Make amends for (a past error or sin).
examples: A poor game was redeemed in the second half.
He redeemed his watch from the pawnshop.
The company was unable to redeem its bonds.
God sent his Son to redeem us from sin.
He redeemed his honour by his bravery.
